note:
THE PERMANENT GLOBAL VISUAL BASELINE. Tyler's ruling: every new room inherits visually from APPROVED GAME ART, and Room 1 is a permanent global reference for the whole of production -- not a first link in a chain.

WHY A CHAIN IS THE FAILURE MODE. If Room N is generated from Room N-1 and Room N+1 from Room N, each step is a plausible small drift and forty steps is a different game. Nobody sees it happen, because every individual comparison looks right. Anchoring every room to Room 1 makes the drift measurable against a fixed thing instead of against its own parent.

THESE ARE ACTUAL IMAGES, NOT PROSE DESCRIPTIONS. A paragraph describing the palette cannot be transmitted to an image model and cannot be hashed. Every entry here is a file, and the production record hashes each one before any generation call.

NO SIMILARITY SCORE. This file identifies what must be supplied; it does not judge the result. Tyler's eye is the only aesthetic authority and no tool here ranks, scores or grades a picture.

A.note: The whole frame as the game draws it -- play area, verb panel, type. It is what the game LOOKS LIKE, which is a different question from what a plate looks like, and it is the one reference that carries the interface's colour and weight.

B.note: The promoted plate at 1920x864. The reference for handling, edge quality, value range and how much detail a plate carries at shipping size.

C.note: The canonical protagonist frame, from content/actors/thad.json's `stand` front clip. He appears in every room, so any room whose art disagrees with him is the room that is wrong.

visualTypes.note: Broad type only, and declared rather than inferred. A tool guessing 'interior' from a room's name would be guessing about the picture.

comparable.note: D -- the closest approved comparable. The Nugget is the only approved INTERIOR plate at shipping size in the repository. It is a public interior and the assay office is an institutional one, which errata 54's material table separates by identity material -- the Nugget is warm timber, the assay office is grey, bone, glass and brass. So it is the closest comparable and not a model to match: it establishes interior light, depth and plate handling, not the room's palette.

casting.note: THE APPROVED ROOM 1 CASTING SHEET (reference/casting/README.md): Thad, Hob, the driver, the coach, in the room, in one generation. It is the closest approved thing to what a Room 5 composition master IS, and Tyler's rejection of master-01 was a rendering-vocabulary failure this sheet defines by example: a coarse visible pixel grid, dithered gradients, faces as a few pixels, clothing as flat broad tones. Transmitted on every Room 5 art call.

THE CORRECTED COMPOSITION MASTER IS HER CASTING SHEET (doc 38 section 1). Master-01 was rejected by Tyler as visual ancestry; master-02 was generated with the approved Room 1 casting sheet as its primary reference and answers the three named defects. Every later Winnie call points at THIS image. Staged, non-shipping, not Tyler-approved: it satisfies slot E for the purpose of deriving her and says nothing about acceptance.
